title: Cang Yutian's Test
next_chapter_hook: Just as Cang Yutian was about to reveal the truth that shocked Chen Ji, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly violently trembled—Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out urgently: 'Don't believe him! He's tampering with memories!'

text.content: The images on the fragment shattered like a broken mirror, and Chen Ji's consciousness was violently pulled back to reality. Cold sweat soaked his back, and he discovered he was still kneeling before the Tianji Record, the candle flames somehow having extinguished by half. 'Chen Nian...' he murmured, his knuckles white from the intensity. That blurry silhouette—his missing sister, the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' taken by the Holy Sect—why had she appeared in his prophetic vision? Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul quivered faintly on the first page, as if it held countless unspoken words sealed within.

dialogue.content: 'It seems you've finally seen it.' A voice rang out from the void, neither male nor female, neither old nor young, yet carrying a pressure that made all things bow. Chen Ji abruptly looked up, and in the sealed chamber where all candle flames had died, a figure was materializing from emptiness—a face beyond description, features sometimes blurry, sometimes clear, as if Heaven's Way itself was manifesting before mortals. 'The master of the Tianji Record...' the figure smiled faintly, 'No, I should call you the eye of Cang Yutian in this world.'

text.content: Chen Ji felt an invisible pressure squeezing in from all directions, as if the entire heavens and earth were scrutinizing him. His Heavenly Fate instantly decreased by 5 points—this was the Tianji Record warning him. He forced himself not to kneel, but his knees were already trembling slightly. 'Cang Yutian...' he quickly searched for this name in his mind. Mo Xiansheng had once mentioned that the Eye of Heaven's Way was not a specific person, but a transcendent consciousness. Could the one before him be that consciousness's representative in the mortal world?

dialogue.content: 'Correct, you're quite clever.' Cang Yutian's voice carried a playful tone, 'Every prophetic seer throughout history has been my chess piece; the Tianji Record is merely one thread I've laid among mortals. But you...' he stepped forward, the pressure suddenly intensifying, 'You surprise me. A mere废物, yet able to reach today.' Chen Ji felt sweetness rise in his throat, a thread of blood seeping from the corner of his lips. He bit down hard on his tongue, using pain to stay alert. Remembered—he told himself coldly—wait for the moment.

text.content: 'I came today to give you an opportunity.' Cang Yutian's tone suddenly became careless, as if bestowing charity upon a roadside beggar, 'You're searching for Chen Nian, I know. The Holy Sect has hidden her well; even I had to expend some effort to find her. But if you're willing—' he raised his hand, a screen of light appearing, and on it was clearly Chen Nian imprisoned. 'I can directly tell you where she is.' Chen Ji's pupils violently contracted, his fingernails digging deeply into his palms. The sound of blood dripping to the ground was especially clear in the silence.

choice.prompt: The deal Cang Yutian proposed left Chen Ji torn—his sister's information versus his independent will

choices.description: Exchange loyalty for Chen Nian's whereabouts, rescue her first—vows can be broken anyway.
choices.risk_hint: Once you agree, Cang Yutian will bind you with a 'Heavenly Way Contract'

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, pressing all the surging killing intent deep within his gaze. 'Good.' His voice was terrifyingly calm. Cang Yutian seemed very satisfied, about to speak, when Chen Ji suddenly smiled—that smile was cold as ice in the twelfth month: 'But I have one condition.' He slowly raised his head, 'Before Chen Nian sees me, no one may harm her. Otherwise—' the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly lit up, 'My loyalty, you cannot afford.'

choices.description: Never bow to any force, even if facing Heaven's Way. Chen Nian, he will save himself.
choices.visible_cost: May be killed or seriously injured on the spot
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may directly erase you

text.content: 'No.' Chen Ji spat out this word, his voice not loud, but utterly resolute. Cang Yutian narrowed his eyes, the pressure suddenly intensifying tenfold, and Chen Ji felt his internal organs shifting. But he still stood straight, the corners of his mouth even curving into a hint of mockery: 'The Eye of Heaven's Way? Hmph, in this life of mine, the one thing I never lack is being used as someone's chess piece. Since we're all chess pieces—' he wiped the blood from his lips, 'Why not be the one holding the chess pieces?'

choices.description: Pretend to consider, extract more information, while secretly seeking opportunities to escape or counter.
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may see through your disguise

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, his gaze flickering uncertainly. Cang Yutian seemed to see through his hesitation, the oppressive pressure easing slightly as he waited for a response. "...I need to know more first." Chen Ji spoke slowly, his tone carrying just the right amount of greed and wariness. "What exactly does your 'loyalty' entail? What else can I gain beyond Chen Nian?" He lowered his gaze, hiding the coldness within—it was an act, and he was good at this. Cang Yutian smiled: "As expected of a clever one."

Cang Yutian's figure paced slowly through the secret chamber, each step making the space tremble slightly. "Do you know why the Tianji Record chose you?" He didn't answer directly, instead posing another question. Chen Ji's pupils contracted—this was also an answer he had always wanted to know. "Because of your destiny," Cang Yutian turned around, an enigmatic smile appearing on that indescribable face. "Or rather... because you are a chess piece chosen by Chen Xuan." The seal left by Mo Xiansheng suddenly vibrated violently, as if this name had touched some forbidden taboo.

dialogue.content: "Chen Xuan... that lunatic who tried to defy heaven." Cang Yutian's tone carried a trace of mockery. "He thought that by passing the Tianji Record to you, he could escape my control. Unfortunately—" He raised his hand, and a screen of light appeared again, showing a scene Chen Ji had never seen: Chen Xuan, before his death, stuffing the Tianji Record into an infant's swaddling clothes! "You think you accidentally obtained the inheritance? No, from the very beginning, you were his carefully cultivated chess piece for opposing heaven's will. And now—" Cang Yutian spread his arms wide, "It's time for you to fulfill your last bit of usefulness."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a chill crawl from his feet up his spine. Chen Xuan... that ancestor he had never seen in his memories, had set up this game from the very beginning? And he, thinking he was resisting fate, had always been just a piece on the chessboard? Rage,不甘, fear—the emotions intertwined, but in the end, he forced them all down. He took a deep breath, looked up and stared directly at Cang Yutian: "So what? You came today just to tell me this?" His voice was unexpectedly calm, "Or does heaven's way also need to mock mortals for entertainment?"

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian laughed lightly, that laughter echoing through the secret chamber, making Chen Ji's eardrums ache. "Interesting soul." He stopped walking. "I came to give you one last chance. The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the fatal backlash of destiny—you should know this better than anyone." He extended his hand, and an ancient rune appeared in his palm. "Make a contract with me, and you will gain the power to resist the backlash. As for Chen Nian..." He paused, "I can make her the new 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' completely severing her karma with the Tianji Record. That way, you'll never have to worry about blurry prophetic visions again."

choice.prompt: Cang Yutian proposes a plan for Chen Nian to replace Chen Ji in bearing the heavenly fate backlash.

choices.description: Sacrificing his sister's freedom in exchange for her survival—would Chen Nian understand?
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian would be forever bound within the heavenly system
choices.visible_reward: Completely escape the threat of backlash
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may forever lose her free will

text.content: Chen Ji's hand trembled slightly. Sacrifice his sister's freedom? He didn't even dare to imagine what expression Chen Nian would have if she knew. But alive—at least she would be alive... Just as he was about to speak, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burned intensely, and a familiar voice exploded in his mind: "Idiot! He wants you to hand the knife to the Heavenly Dao yourself!" It was Mo Xiansheng! Chen Ji's whole body shuddered, instantly sobering.

choices.description: Never let Chen Nian bear any cost in his place—even at the cost of his own life.
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian might turn hostile on the spot

text.content: "No." Chen Ji's voice was cold as ice. "Chen Nian is not a bargaining chip, nor anyone's tool." He stared directly at Cang Yutian. "You think threatening my family will make me submit?" For the first time, a subtle change appeared on Cang Yutian's expression—rage, or perhaps... appreciation? "Interesting." He said softly, "What if I told you that if you refuse this plan, she will die?"

choices.description: Point out the flaw in Cang Yutian's words—he needs Chen Ji alive, which means Chen Ji has value, so let's negotiate the terms.
choices.visible_cost: May expose his own trump cards

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of mockery: "Honored Cang Yutian, if you could so easily take my life, why waste all this breath?" He stared directly into those eyes that seemed to contain the laws of heaven and earth. "You need me alive, which means I have value. Since that's the case—" He took a step forward, actually approaching Cang Yutian proactively. "Let's try a different approach. What I want, what you can offer—let's negotiate fairly." The temperature in the secret chamber seemed to drop suddenly.

The secret chamber fell into an eerie silence. Cang Yutian gazed at Chen Ji, and on that constantly shifting face, a complex expression emerged—anger, surprise, appreciation, finally turning into a soft sigh. "Interesting," he said. "All these years, countless prophets have trembled before me, willingly offering everything to seek a chance at survival." He stepped back, his form beginning to fade. "You are the first to dare negotiate with me." Chen Ji didn't relax his vigilance, gripping the Tianji Record Fragment tightly in his hand.

dialogue.content: Since you want to negotiate—" Cang Yutian's voice began echoing from all directions, "then I'll give you a task." The light screen reappeared, displaying a map marking the locations of the Three Great Sects and the Holy Sect, along with a region pulsing with dangerous red light—the Ancient Forbidden Land. "The Ancient Forbidden Land is about to open, and there's something I need inside." Cang Yutian said, "Bring it to me, and I'll tell you Chen Nian's exact location, as well as—" his voice turned meaningful, "the location of the missing fifth page of the Tianji Record."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart lurched. The fifth page of the Tianji Record—that was a missing section even Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned. Legend said the Tianji Record contained nine pages, yet what he held was merely a fragment. If the fifth page truly existed... He forced himself to remain calm, his expression blank as he spoke: "What do you want?" Cang Yutian's laughter echoed through the secret chamber: "Clever. Don't worry, it's nothing dangerous—only a corpse deep within the forbidden grounds." A corpse? Chen Ji furrowed his brow. What kind of corpse would the Heavenly Dao itself bother to mention?

dialogue.content: "That was the cultivator from the ancient era who first attempted to defy heaven." Cang Yutian's voice grew low, "He failed, and his corpse was sealed in the deepest part of the forbidden grounds." Before the words finished, a golden light suddenly blazed through the secret chamber, and Cang Yutian's form dissolved completely, leaving only words lingering in the air: "Three months later, the forbidden grounds will open. I'll give you three months to consider." Chen Ji stood still, the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand radiating gentle warmth. Three months... That would be enough. He coldly smirked in his heart. Cang Yutian, did you think you were the only one playing chess?

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul violently quivered on the first page, an elderly voice transmitting into Chen Ji's mind: "Master... What Cang Yutian referred to as the 'first heaven-defying one' was Chen Xuan's master. In other words—" Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply, "the sealed remains in the forbidden grounds are Chen Xuan's master's bones?" Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment: "It's not just that. On that corpse lies the true core of the Tianji Record... which is the source of the ability to 'foresee three hours into the future' that you have been seeking." Chen Ji gripped the fragment tightly, his knuckles turning white. What the Heavenly Dao wanted was not some corpse, but to reclaim the power it had once lost. And he was merely a tool used by the Heavenly Dao to retrieve its treasure.

The candle flame reignited, and the secret chamber returned to stillness. Chen Ji leaned against the wall, gasping heavily. The Heavenly Fate had consumed a full 23 points—this was nearly one-third of his current total. More troublesome was that Cang Yutian knew of Chen Nian's existence, which meant the Holy Sect's movements were also under the control of this "Heavenly Will." He needed allies, needed intelligence, needed to lay out a chess game within three months that could oppose the Heavenly Dao. Ye Qing should have some results, and Su Qingyao might know some inside information about the Ancient Forbidden Land... He quickly sorted through the clues in his mind, a cold smirk curling at the corner of his lips: Cang Yutian, did you think I was a chess piece? Then let me show you how a chess piece devours the Chess Player.
